\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{pgf}
\usepgflibrary{fpu}
\newcommand{\probe}[1]{\pgfmathparse{#1}\typeout{ROUNDPROBE:\mode;#1;\pgfmathresult}}

  \probe{round(2.499999)}
  \probe{round(-2.499999)}

  \probe{round(-2.49999)}
